prompt:
EDIT referenced Hairen image. Preserve exact face, body pose, both five-finger WEBBED hands, sea/rocks and light. Change only brown draped material over hips and thighs: it is NOT fabric or trousers. Replace it with heavy hanging natural SKIN FLAPS, same wet smooth grey-olive living skin as webbed hands, broad glossy organic folds, no cloth weave, seams, tassels, cords or hems. These loose body skin folds hang like hakama while a separate opaque dark charcoal undergarment fully covers torso and pelvis beneath, absolutely no nudity. Make one SECOND webbed foot visible near lower-right side below folds, not an extra leg; total two arms/two legs. No extra fingers. Original specification: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Hairen, webbed sea humanoid of Chinese and Edo accounts.
ANATOMY: ONE sea-dwelling adult HUMANLIKE being with ONE head, TWO eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs; BOTH hands and BOTH feet have large clearly visible skin WEBBING between five digits [hairen-c01,hairen-c02]. Loose folded outer skin hangs like billowing HAKAMA TROUSERS over hips and thighs [hairen-c03], but modest opaque dark cloth underlayer fully covers torso/pelvis, no nudity. No fish tail, turtle body, horns, gills or invented fins.
MOMENT: Haul upward from dark water onto a wet rock right toward viewer, both broad webbed hands spread on rock foreground, webbed feet brace separately on lower rocks, face turns up in defiant untamed scrutiny. Hanging hakama-like skin folds visible at sides, no human victims.
POWER: Captured creature could not be tamed [hairen-c05]; no invented magic. Physical strength of climbing and waves only.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; low sea-rock angle full crouched body, both webbed hands/feet readable and unambiguously joined by membrane, no giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moon, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, ordinary water spray or dust.
SURFACE: tactile wet skin, coarse cloth, scales, hair, old wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Sea water and coastal rocks of sea-dwelling accounts [hairen-c01,hairen-c02].
MOOD: imposing and active, never cute, calm or decorative. Sacred protective figures remain dignified and reverential.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Hairen, webbed sea humanoid of Chinese and Edo accounts

aura: Documented anatomy and action create presence without generic aura.
artistic_choices: Combine nonconflicting webbed anatomy and hakama skin accounts, not distinct turtle-bodied haihoshang c07. Opaque modesty underlayer and rocky climb editorial.
